mainEntity.name: How much do coordinated AI assistants really cost once I include subscriptions, automation, and all the fixing?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost can include AI subscriptions, automation platforms, connected business tools, storage, implementation time, review time, and any custom technical work. Multiple assistants may increase model usage because each one consumes tokens for instructions, context, reasoning, and tool interactions. Concurrent workflows can raise usage quickly, while sequential workflows may be easier to control but add steps. Begin with the least expensive setup that can test the business case, and track cost per completed workflow rather than looking only at monthly subscription prices. Run My AI Biz’s newsletter has a free starting option and a listed paid subscription of $9 per month for full weekly issues; that educational subscription is separate from any external tools or mastermind resources.
acceptedAnswer.description: Budget for AI tools, automation services, connected apps, setup, and human review—not just a chatbot subscription. Track cost per completed workflow and token use. Run My AI Biz lists a free option and a $9 monthly paid newsletter subscription, separate from other tools or programs.
